map.A 组展示 10000、点击 500（CTR 5.0%）；B 组展示 10000: Variant A: 10000 impressions, 500 clicks (CTR 5.0%); variant B: 10000 impressions, 580 clicks (CTR 5.8%). The two-proportion z test gives a p value of about 0.11 (not significant at α=0.05), so the gap may be random; keep scaling up to 30000+ impressions per group before deciding.
map.显著性水平 α 是什么？: What is the significance level α?
map.α 是'误判差异显著'的可接受风险，常用 0.05（95% 置信）。α 越小越保: α is the acceptable risk of wrongly judging a difference as significant, commonly 0.05 (95% confidence). The smaller α is, the more conservative and the harder it is to reach significance. map.样本量不够能下结论吗？: Can I conclude anything with too few impressions?
map.不够时差异极易被噪声掩盖或放大。经验上每组至少数千曝光、数十次点击再检验较稳；未: No, with too few the difference is easily masked or inflated by noise. As experience goes, testing is steadier with at least several thousand impressions and dozens of clicks per group; until then treat it as directional reference only and do not stop a creative version on that basis.
